source_name: BQK — Financial supervision / licensed institutions portal (EN+SQ)
why_relevant: Landing page of the licensing/supervision department; publishes licence grants, revocations and regulatory notices for payment institutions and e-money institutions. New licence announcements are the earliest signal that a payments employer is standing up a Kosovo team (country manager, compliance, AML, operations hires typically follow within months).

source_name: Draft Law on Payment Services (Projektligji për Shërbimet e Pagesave) — Office of the Prime Minister
why_relevant: The PSD2-style payment services law reshapes who may operate as a payment institution / PSP in Kosovo. Regulatory openings drive a wave of new licensed entities and of compliance/PCI/AML/open-banking hiring — an early leading indicator for the payments employer landscape, plus a canonical source of the legal terminology used in job ads.

source_name: DuaPune.com — employer job pages (incl. PayLink)
why_relevant: Job board covering both Kosovo and Albania with stable per-employer URLs. Critically, it already carries a PayLink employer page — PayLink being the regional card processing/personalisation house serving Kosovo banks. Cross-border (AL+XK) coverage matters because several payments employers hire for Kosovo out of Tirana.

source_name: ShpalljePune.com — active vacancy listings Kosovo
why_relevant: Secondary Kosovo job aggregator. Smaller payments firms and MTO agent networks that do not pay for KosovaJob placement frequently post only here, so it broadens the employer census beyond the big banks.

source_name: GjejPune.com — Kosovo job platform
why_relevant: Additional Kosovo vacancy platform; useful as a redundancy channel so a single portal's paywall or blocking does not create a hiring-signal blind spot for payments employers.

source_name: PunaIme.org — Kosovo employment platform (finance category)
why_relevant: Self-described large Kosovo employment platform with sector browsing including finance and technology — the two categories under which PSP/fintech roles are filed. Useful for catching fintech engineering/integration roles that finance-only filters miss.

source_name: FIKS — FinTech Kosovo cluster
why_relevant: Industry cluster for financial services / fintech / payments in Kosovo. Its membership roster is a curated actor map of the non-bank payments employer landscape (founding members observed: Numarics, OneFor, Paysera, Swinto; powered by KDWV), and cluster chairmanship is itself a leadership-move signal (Kristian Kabashi of Numarics reported as first chair). Has sq and sr language versions (/home-alb, /home-srb).

source_name: Paysera Kosova — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Paysera is reported as holding the first e-money institution licence granted by BQK — the flagship non-bank payments employer in Kosovo. Its LinkedIn page carries hiring posts, headcount trend and named leadership/appointment posts that never reach Albanian job boards.

source_name: Paysera corporate blog / newsroom (Kosovo expansion)
why_relevant: First-party corporate communications on the Kosovo market entry — office openings, country leadership and team build-out are announced here before local media picks them up. A model 'company newsroom' source for the EMI segment.

source_name: Unioni Financiar Prishtinë (UFP) — Western Union master agent for Kosovo
why_relevant: UFP is described as the Western Union Financial Services agent for Kosovo since 2000 with 170+ locations — the single largest money-transfer-operator employer/network in the country and a first-class payments employer entirely invisible to bank-focused searches. Its 'Behu agjent' (become an agent) and locations pages document network expansion, which is the MTO analogue of headcount growth.

source_name: Moneta (monetaks.com) — Kosovo non-bank money transfer & payments institution
why_relevant: Self-described leading Kosovo non-banking financial institution for fast money transfers and payments. A pure-play payments employer (branch network, agent operations, compliance/AML roles) that would never surface in bank-name searches. Corporate site is the primary channel for its own vacancy and management announcements.

source_name: MoneyGram agent locator — Kosovo
why_relevant: Enumerates MoneyGram agent/partner outlets in Kosovo. The agent list is an indirect census of which Kosovo entities (banks, exchange bureaus, retail chains, MFIs) operate payments businesses and therefore staff payments roles — a way to discover employers not named in any register search.

source_name: PayLink — card processing & personalisation (Albania/Kosovo regional processor)
why_relevant: PayLink is a technology/card-processing and personalisation company serving the regional banking market, with a PayLink-branded local card scheme accepted on local terminals under PCI standards. It is the archetypal processor employer for the cell (processing, PCI, card personalisation, integration roles) and is registered in Albania while serving Kosovo — so Kosovo-relevant hiring appears under an Albanian entity.

source_name: OpenCorporates.al — Albanian corporate registry mirror (payments entities serving XK)
why_relevant: Registry records expose directors, administrators and shareholding changes for payments companies. Because processors and PSPs serving Kosovo are frequently Albanian-registered (PayLink among them), this registry captures leadership changes that no Kosovo source publishes. Officer-change filings are the hardest evidence available for 'leadership moves'.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) — Official Gazette
why_relevant: Publishes the laws and secondary regulation governing banks, microfinance and non-bank financial institutions (Law No. 04/L-093) and, when enacted, the payment services law. Sets the legal categories under which payments employers are licensed, and thus the vocabulary used by regulators, recruiters and journalists.

source_name: The Kosovo Banker (SHBK / Kosovo Banking Association magazine) on Issuu
why_relevant: Sector magazine of the Kosovo Banking Association. Carries profiles of payment infrastructure players (PayLink's local card scheme and PCI compliance were described in its pages), executive interviews and appointment notices — a rich, under-indexed narrative source for who leads payments functions and how card processing is organised in Kosovo.

source_name: Insajderi — Kosovo news outlet (sq + en), fintech/payments coverage
why_relevant: Publishes in Albanian and English on payments-company market entries and on the corporate affairs of fintech founders (both the Paysera Kosovo expansion and reporting touching Numarics/Kristian Kabashi were found here). Useful for leadership-move and reputational-event signals around payments executives.

source_name: IndeksOnline — Kosovo news (sq) payments-sector coverage
why_relevant: High-traffic Albanian-language outlet that covered the Paysera payment-network expansion into Kosovo. Local-language press is where PSP office openings, country-manager appointments and partnership announcements land first, often days before any English coverage.

source_name: Swinto — cross-border payments app (CH/Western Europe → Kosovo)
why_relevant: FIKS founding member; app offering instant transfers and payments to customers in Switzerland, Western Europe and Kosovo, with Prishtina-based operations. Observed hiring directly via its own channels (Chief Accountant; client advisors, applications to hr@swinto.com) rather than via job boards — a reminder that diaspora-remittance fintechs recruit through social/company channels.

source_name: OneFor Kosova — money app, Prishtina (Facebook company page)
why_relevant: FIKS founding member with a Prishtina presence, positioning as a personal money-transfer app. Facebook is the primary recruitment and announcement channel for consumer fintechs targeting the Kosovo/diaspora market, so vacancies and team news appear here rather than on job boards.

source_name: PTK / Posta e Kosovës & Vala — state postal-financial and telecom payment channels
why_relevant: Post and Telecom of Kosovo operates postal payment/remittance counters and (historically) the Vala mobile brand — postal and telecom operators are payments employers in their own right (bill payment, mobile money, agent networks) and, as public enterprises, must publish vacancies and board appointments officially. Establishes the actor; official vacancy channels should then be scouted on postakosoves.com / kosovotelecom.com.

source_name: Vreme (sr) — reporting on payment-transaction regime affecting Kosovo Serb community
why_relevant: The only substantive Serbian-language thread found for this cell: coverage of Kosovo curtailing dinar payment traffic ('platni promet') with central Serbia, including the reported closure of NLB Komercijalna's nine Kosovo branches. Such regime changes destroy and create payments jobs in northern municipalities and force PSP/branch reorganisations — a leading indicator for organization-change signals on the Serbian-language side.

source_name: Poslovi Infostud — Serbian-language job board (regional/inostranstvo listings)
why_relevant: Dominant Serbian-language job board. It is the realistic channel for Serbian-language payments vacancies relevant to northern Kosovo and for regional PSPs recruiting Serbian speakers, since no dedicated Kosovo-Serb payments job portal was found. 'Platni promet' is a standard role keyword there.

source_name: PunaIme.org (KosovaJob network)
why_relevant: Sister property of the KosovaJob network with its own /konkursi/<slug> permalinks. Carries banking and collections/call-centre roles (e.g. 'Mbikeqyres/e i/e Ri/e Bankar/e', 'Zyrtar/e per Thirrje ne Kolektime'). Because it is a separate render of overlapping inventory it is a useful redundancy/deduplication partner when KosovaJob blocks or expires an ad.

source_name: Portal Pune (portalpune.com)
why_relevant: Second-tier but high-volume Kosovo board; its Facebook page shows it routinely posts bank konkurse (ProCredit Bank etc.) with links of form portalpune.com/jobs/<numeric-id>, and it exposes tag pages such as /jobs/tag/Vende-pune-ne-Kosove. Numeric IDs make incremental ID-walking collection cheap.

source_name: Njoftime.com - jobs threads
why_relevant: Forum-style Albanian-language classifieds covering both Albania and Kosovo. Carries strikingly specific bank ads - 'Specialist/Senior Specialist - Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave' and 'Specialist ne Njesine e Digjitalizimit dhe Kanaleve Alternative te Shperndarjes' - i.e. explicit cards/payments and digital-channel unit names. Thread IDs are sequential (/threads/<slug>.<id>/), and forum threads are rarely deleted, so it doubles as an archive of expired ads that boards purge.

source_name: ShpalljePune.com
why_relevant: Aggregator of active konkurse in Kosovo. Aggregators are valuable because they normalise employer names across boards and often surface small PSP/microfinance employers that the two big boards under-index.
